create_matrix_game: create a matrix game using pyspiel.create_matrix_game with payoff matrices for two players
load_matrix_game: load a pre-defined matrix game from pyspiel by name such as blotto or matrix_mp
build_game_manually: build a game manually using pyspiel.GameType and pyspiel.MatrixGame building blocks
run_game_simulation: run a game simulation by creating a state, applying random actions, and printing player utilities
import_payoff_data: import payoff data from a text file and create a matrix game from numpy arrays
